files.description: ZIP archive containing the EHI Export All Tables data dictionary PDF. This is the primary artifact — a 7,492-page PDF documenting 561 unique database tables and 71,903 columns across 13 schemas that comprise the myAvatar EHI export.

Extracted PDF from the ZIP. 7,492-page data dictionary documenting all myAvatar EHI export tables, organized by form. Each table entry includes table name, description, and column-level detail (name, type, max length, description). Created 2023-10-02 by Dru Anne Walz.
Plain text extraction of the PDF via pdftotext. 318,819 lines. Used as input for the enrichment extraction script.
Raw HTML of the myAvatar EHI export documentation page. Contains explanatory text about the export mechanism and the download link to the ZIP file.
Browser screenshot of the myAvatar EHI export page showing the page title, explanatory text, and download link.

Bun TypeScript script that parses the pdftotext output into structured JSON. Extracts form names, table names, table descriptions, and column-level detail (name, type, max_length, description). Also categorizes tables by data domain.

Structured JSON extraction of all 906 table entries from the PDF. Each entry contains form_name, table_name, schema, table_short_name, table_description, and columns array. 561 unique tables, 71,903 total columns.
Aggregate statistics from the enrichment extraction: table counts, column counts, description coverage percentages, schema breakdown, and data domain categorization with sample table names.
Documentation for the enrichment pipeline: run commands, input boundary, output files, and known parsing limitations.
